Name: Experience HUD - Highly Customizable XP Showcase
Author: n1truss
Description:
Experience HUD is a highly customizable XP HUD that shows experience bars in a list or on XP gain. You can customize this to your hearts content with different frames and colours, scale and positioning.

It also auto-detects any SpaceCore skills. These aren't required, just supported. (Spacecore as a requirement to show compatibility only.)

Take a look at the pictures for a few different ways you can make this mod yours!

Shouldn't have any incompatibilities, please post any issues.

Consider endorsement please :)

Manifest.Name: Experience HUD
Manifest.Description: Configurable experience bars for vanilla and SpaceCore skills.
